name: Ghost Are Good Hosts
source:
You think you’re attending a refined soirée with friends, but the Château de Carnelle hides a secret – its guests are ghosts, and they’re very hungry. Befriend them, or risk becoming their next victim.

[From [url=https://leondaydreamer.itch.io/ghost-are-good-hosts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你以为自己正在与朋友一起参加一场精致的晚会，但卡内尔城堡却隐藏着一个秘密——它的客人都是鬼魂，而且他们非常饥饿。与他们交朋友，否则就有可能成为他们的下一个受害者。

[来自[url=https://leondaydreamer.itch.io/ghost-are-good-hosts]Itch.io[/url]]
